dishes.name: Döner
dishes.desc: Seasoned meat stacked on a vertical rotisserie, sliced thinly and served on a plate, in bread or wrapped in flatbread.

dishes.name: Iskender Kebap
dishes.desc: Bursa dish of thin döner slices over pide bread, topped with tomato sauce, browned butter and yoghurt.

dishes.name: Adana Kebap
dishes.desc: Spicy hand-minced lamb kebab with red pepper flakes grilled on wide skewers over charcoal.

dishes.name: Şiş Kebap
dishes.desc: Cubes of marinated lamb or chicken grilled on skewers over charcoal.

dishes.name: Lahmacun
dishes.desc: Thin crisp flatbread topped with spiced minced meat, onions and peppers, rolled up with parsley and lemon.

dishes.name: Pide
dishes.desc: Boat-shaped flatbread baked in a stone oven with toppings like minced meat, cheese, egg or sucuk.

dishes.name: Börek
dishes.desc: Pastry of thin yufka dough layered or rolled with cheese, spinach or minced meat, baked or fried.

dishes.name: Menemen
dishes.desc: Breakfast dish of eggs softly scrambled with tomatoes, green peppers and spices in a small pan.

dishes.name: Simit
dishes.desc: Ring-shaped bread dipped in grape molasses and coated with sesame seeds, sold by street vendors.

dishes.name: Mantı
dishes.desc: Tiny meat-filled dumplings topped with garlic yoghurt and red pepper butter, especially from Kayseri.

dishes.name: İmam Bayıldı
dishes.desc: Whole aubergine stuffed with onions, garlic and tomatoes, braised in olive oil and served at room temperature.

dishes.name: Köfte
dishes.desc: Grilled or fried meatballs of minced lamb or beef with onions and spices, with many regional styles.

dishes.name: Mercimek Çorbası
dishes.desc: Smooth red lentil soup with onion, carrot and cumin, served with lemon and red pepper butter.

dishes.name: Baklava
dishes.desc: Layered filo pastry filled with pistachios or walnuts and soaked in syrup, famously from Gaziantep.

dishes.name: Künefe
dishes.desc: Hot dessert of shredded kadayıf pastry around stretchy unsalted cheese, soaked in syrup and topped with pistachios.

dishes.name: Lokum
dishes.desc: Soft cubes of starch and sugar gel flavoured with rosewater, lemon or pistachio, dusted with icing sugar.

dishes.name: Turkish Breakfast
dishes.desc: Spread of cheeses, olives, tomatoes, cucumbers, eggs, honey, kaymak, jams and bread with tea.

dishes.name: Gözleme
dishes.desc: Thin hand-rolled flatbread filled with cheese, spinach or potato and cooked on a griddle.

dishes.name: Balık Ekmek
dishes.desc: Grilled mackerel fillet in bread with onions and salad, sold from boats by Istanbul's Galata Bridge.

dishes.name: Dolma
dishes.desc: Vegetables or vine leaves stuffed with spiced rice, pine nuts and currants or minced meat.

dishes.name: Sütlaç
dishes.desc: Rice pudding of milk, rice and sugar, often baked until browned on top and dusted with cinnamon.

dishes.name: Turkish Tea
dishes.desc: Strong black tea from the Black Sea coast brewed in a double teapot and served in tulip glasses.

dishes.name: Turkish Coffee
dishes.desc: Finely ground coffee boiled with water and sugar in a cezve, served unfiltered with its grounds.

dishes.name: Ayran
dishes.desc: Cold salty drink of yoghurt diluted with water, often served with kebabs.

dishes.name: Karnıyarık
dishes.desc: Fried aubergines split open and filled with minced meat, onions, tomatoes and peppers, then baked.

dishes.name: Rakı
dishes.desc: Anise-flavoured grape spirit that turns cloudy with water, drunk with meze and fish.

dishes.name: Çiğ Köfte
dishes.desc: Spicy patties of bulgur kneaded with pepper paste and spices, wrapped in lettuce or lavash with lemon.

dishes.name: Kumpir
dishes.desc: Large baked potato mashed with butter and cheese and loaded with toppings, sold at Ortaköy stalls.

dishes.name: Kokoreç
dishes.desc: Lamb intestines wrapped around offal, grilled on a spit, chopped with spices and served in bread.

dishes.name: Hünkar Beğendi
dishes.desc: Ottoman dish of tender lamb stew served over smoky aubergine purée with cheese.

dishes.name: Ezogelin Çorbası
dishes.desc: Red lentil and bulgur soup with dried mint and paprika butter.

dishes.name: Kuru Fasulye
dishes.desc: White bean stew in tomato sauce, often with meat, served with rice pilaf.

dishes.name: Mücver
dishes.desc: Courgette fritters with dill and feta, served with garlic yoghurt.

dishes.name: Cacık
dishes.desc: Yoghurt with cucumber, garlic and mint, thinned with water.

dishes.name: Beyti Kebap
dishes.desc: Minced lamb kebab wrapped in lavash, sliced and topped with tomato sauce and yoghurt.

dishes.name: Kazandibi
dishes.desc: Milk pudding with a caramelised bottom, folded and served cold.

dishes.name: Salep
dishes.desc: Hot winter drink of milk thickened with orchid-root flour and topped with cinnamon.

dishes.name: Şalgam
dishes.desc: Tangy fermented juice of purple carrots and turnip, drunk with kebabs.

dishes.name: Maraş Dondurması
dishes.desc: Stretchy ice cream thickened with salep and mastic, served by teasing vendors.

dishes.name: Midye Dolma
dishes.desc: Mussels stuffed with spiced rice, eaten with lemon from Istanbul street carts.

dishes.name: Tantuni
dishes.desc: Mersin chopped beef sizzled with cotton oil and spices, wrapped in thin lavash.

dishes.name: Hamsi Tava
dishes.desc: Black Sea anchovies dusted in cornmeal and fried in a round pan.

dishes.name: Kısır
dishes.desc: Bulgur salad with tomato paste, herbs and pomegranate molasses.
